Subject: Internal: Approval request — CardioHealth pilot exceptions (14d retention + pilot credit)

Marissa — looping you and legal/SE for quick internal clearance. Summary and ask below.

Deal: CardioHealth (CH-2026-47) — target pilot Jan 11. Sales owner: Ben Carter. CS: Monica Patel.

External asks: 
 - Data retention: request to restrict retention to 14 days for pilot (vs our default 30 days). This is specific to request/response logs and KV/prefix cache data.
 - Pilot discount: procurement asking for a one-off 40% credit applied to first invoice (they said \"ANC 40%\" as shorthand).

Impact / notes: 
 - Engineering: 14-day retention is feasible; we need to confirm no analytic backfill dependencies. Dev — can you confirm technical feasibility and any rollout caveats?
 - Legal/Security: Rishi — this deviates from standard retention; does legal want a short AIA/data-handling addendum or an SLA variance? Also advise if 40% pilot credit is within standard discounting bands or requires finance approval.
 - Commercial: If approved, I'll propose a capped pilot commitment (e.g., up to $10k usage) to limit exposure and convert to reserved pricing if they expand.

Attachments: MOA-proposal.docx (draft language for data addendum and pilot credit clause)

Requested decision: Can we provisionally approve the 14-day pilot retention and up to 40% one-time pilot credit, contingent on legal sign-off and a capped commitment? If yes, please reply with any edits (Rishi), feasibility notes (Dev), and final thumbs (Marissa). We are aiming to respond to the customer by EOD Monday (Dec 6).

Thanks — Ben
